note: House conventions used when scope.json is silent. Project-independent: no site, client or style is assumed here. src: convention (house default) or observed (measured on a real run).

draft.note: fastest look-only check; below the AI reference-video minimum

low.note: default preview; >= 409,600 px so it is accepted as an AI reference video (src: observed)

final.note: needs a GPU (CPU ~1 min/frame, src: observed)

bytedance/seedance-2.src: observed; confirm with the provider schema before S7

bytedance/seedance-2-5.note: needs a higher Krea plan (src: observed)

style.prefix: Professional architectural visualization film, ultra-realistic, shot on a cinema camera with a prime lens, perfectly stabilized. Follow the reference video's camera path, framing and building layout exactly:
style.suffix: Crisp architectural lines, true verticals, high dynamic range, premium real estate commercial color grade, calm luxurious pacing. No people, no text, no logos.
style.src: convention — project-specific place, materials and mood go in each shot body or scope.style_notes

palette.note: Used only when scope.materials == 'palette' (massing models with flat materials). Matched case-insensitively against the material name: the first keyword contained in the name wins. [r, g, b, roughness].

lamp_defaults.note: street-lamp point lights are added at objects whose name matches object_pattern (regex, case-insensitive) unless scope.lamps says otherwise

krea.note: api-mode paths are NOT yet verified against Krea's REST docs; connector mode (the Krea MCP connector) is the tested path. Verify, then set verified: true.
